subject: Mental Models
title: Leverage Points
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Leverage Points.

hook.text: Archimedes said give me a lever long enough and I can move the world.

buildup.text: Donella Meadows identified twelve leverage points in systems.

discovery.text: Low leverage points are easy to find but weak, like adjusting a thermostat.

twist.text: People usually push on low leverage points because they are obvious.

climax.text: Before acting, ask where does the smallest effort create the biggest change? Seek the leverage point.

punchline.text: Small force at the right point moves everything.

quiz.question: Who identified twelve leverage points in systems?
